name: Worktree-Agnostic Retro Ingestion
hypothesis: If retro reads canonical repo-root metrics (with fallback), insufficient_current_run_data drops to near-zero and Study/Act can run consistently.
change: Add source-resolution logic: main-repo logs first, then persisted iteration metrics; add explicit diagnostics for missing sources.
measurement: Rate of retros with complete current-run data; count of data-quality-blocked retros. Target: >=95% retros with complete current-run dataset.
risk: Path resolution bugs could read stale or wrong run artifacts if repo-root detection is incorrect.

previous_experiment.name: Pre-Launch Diagnostic Gate
previous_experiment.final_summary: Cannot evaluate hypothesis: efficiency data consistently blocked by insufficient_current_run_data due to worktree path issues. Pre-launch diagnostic gate was not implemented during experiment window. Root cause is retro ingestion architecture (worktree-relative log paths), not pre-launch readiness.
